name: ai-product-managers-pack
description: 36 Claude Skills for deciding if AI fits, testing it before launch and keeping it honest after: the AI use case canvas, a failure modes map, the workflow-or-agent decision, model selection and the prototype brief; AI PRDs, success criteria, a behavior contract, human-in-the-loop design and the data privacy brief; system prompt and context engineering briefs, agent specs and tool descriptions; error analysis, golden datasets, synthetic test data, eval rubrics, an LLM-as-a-judge prompt and the eval plan; red teaming, AI UX review, impact assessments, risk registers, questions for legal, launch checklists and launch gates; weekly quality reviews, feedback signals, prompt regression tests, model migration and incident response; unit economics, usage and pricing tests, the feature card and the exec brief. For AI product managers, product managers adding AI features and founders shipping AI products.
